exact: regulation of branching involved in mammary cord morphogenesis by fat precursor cell-epithelial cell signalling

definition: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of branching of the mammary gland cord as a result of a signal being created by a mammary fat precursor cell and its subsequent reception and interpretation by a mammary cord epithelial cell.
label: regulation of branching involved in mammary cord morphogenesis by fat precursor cell-epithelial cell signaling
